title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 5: the song of the vineyard that yielded wild grapes, and the woes against injustice and drunkenness.

questions.text: Where did the well beloved have his vineyard?
questions.explanation: The song says, "My beloved had a vineyard on a very fruitful hill."

questions.text: What did the vineyard yield when the owner looked for grapes?
questions.explanation: He looked for it to yield grapes, but it yielded wild grapes.

questions.text: What does the owner say he will do to his vineyard?
questions.explanation: He says, "I will take away its hedge, and it will be eaten up. I will break down its wall, and it will be trampled down."

answers.text: Plant it again with an even choicer vine
Take away its hedge and break down its wall
Sell it to another vineyard keeper
Burn its tower and wine press with fire

questions.text: What will the owner command the clouds concerning the vineyard?
questions.explanation: He says, "I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain on it."

answers.text: To pour out floods on it
To rain no rain on it

questions.text: Who is the vineyard of Yahweh of Armies?
questions.explanation: The text explains that the vineyard of Yahweh of Armies is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant.

questions.text: A woe is pronounced on those who join house to house and lay what to what?
questions.explanation: The text says, "Woe to those who join house to house, who lay field to field, until there is no room."

questions.text: Why do those under the woe of verse 11 rise up early in the morning?
questions.explanation: The text says, "Woe to those who rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink," staying late into the night until wine inflames them.

questions.text: A woe is pronounced on those who call evil good and put darkness for what?
questions.explanation: The text says, "Woe to those who call evil good, and good evil; who put darkness for light, and light for darkness."

questions.text: For what do the champions at mixing strong drink acquit the guilty?
questions.explanation: They acquit the guilty for a bribe, but deny justice for the innocent.

questions.text: What will the roaring of those who seize their prey and carry it off be like?
questions.explanation: The text says their roaring will be like a lioness, and they will roar like young lions, seizing their prey and carrying it off.

answers.text: Like a lioness and young lions
